shared_elements: large standing human-like figure carved in low relief filling a rectangular panel
figure shown upright, arms apparently held out/bent, possibly holding an object
horizontal bands of incised linear script-like signs covering the panel surface
justification: Both surfaces show a large upright standing figure in low relief set within a rectangular panel whose field is also covered by horizontal registers of incised sign-like text, a fairly specific combination of figure-plus-inscription-band. The differences are that A's figure is a clearly legible winged, bird-headed genie in profile with a bucket and raised hand, whereas B shows only eroded frontal-looking standing figures without discernible wings or attributes, and B places its inscription above rather than across the figure and repeats panels along a wall.
